annotations.title: 受付中の入札公告を探す

description: Use this when the user asks which public tenders are open now in Japan (national agencies, prefectures, municipalities), by keyword, area, category, buyer or deadline. Returns up to 10 notices, nearest deadline first, with the total count. Not for past results: use search_awards. Includes nominated tenders and requests for comments, marked by `notice_type`; use `types` to leave them out. For tenders not yet announced, use search_bid_plans. 受付中の入札公告・公募・プロポーザル・見積合わせ・指名競争・意見招請（官公需・調達）

area.description: Prefecture. Accepts 福岡県, 福岡, Fukuoka, 40 (JIS code), national (国の機関)

buyer.description: Procuring entity: name (part of it is fine, e.g. 福岡市) or a buyer_id

categories.description: One or more of: 物品=goods/supplies, 工事=construction works, 役務=services/outsourcing (業務委託), 保守=maintenance, 設計・調査=design/survey/consulting, IT=systems/software/IT equipment, 賃貸借=lease/rental, イベント=events, その他=other

changed_since.description: Only notices that are new or whose title, deadline, method, eligibility, procedure, period or place changed on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD (for example yesterday, for "what is new or changed since yesterday"). Each result then has `changes`. Changes are recorded once a day; `changes_tracked_since` in the result says from when.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous result, with the same other arguments. Up to 3 pages.

deadline_from.description: Deadline on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD. The result's `today` field gives the current date in Japan. A deadline range leaves out notices whose deadline could not be read; `deadline_unknown_count` in the result says how many of those match the other conditions.

deadline_to.description: Deadline on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD

keyword.description: Words in the title or summary. Space = AND. Example: 庁舎 清掃

response_format.description: concise (default): fewer fields per row. detailed: adds IDs, method, original URL and retrieval date per row.

sort.description: deadline (default): nearest deadline first. newest: most recently published first.

types.description: bid = tenders anyone qualified can apply for; nominated = 指名競争入札, only companies the buyer nominates can bid (no application); opinion = 意見招請・資料提供招請, requests for comments or information, not a tender; items = small goods purchases listing many items in one notice. Default: all types (the same as the site's open list).

name: search_bid_notices

access.description: Whether this result is shown in full through this server: public = yes; not_public_now = the item exists but this server does not return it at present (e.g. a notice whose deadline has passed); login_required / plan_required = the item exists but is available only under other access conditions of the site (sign-in, or a plan)

cite_as.description: One-line source citation for this result: the page title on 入札案件観測所, the data date, and the URL of that page (same as `url`).

try_keyword.description: A different wording of the keyword (synonym) and how many records it matches; call again with keyword set to this

related.description: Facts related to this result (counts) and the tool call that returns them

restricted.description: Items that exist but are not returned here, with their access value. An item listed here is not missing from the data.

changes.description: With changed_since: what happened to this notice on or after that date (new, or which field changed with before/after)

deadline_kind.description: What the `deadline` date is, read from the notice's procedure text: participation application, bid submission, both, opening, question, notification (not a deadline for bidders), document issue, briefing, or unknown

notice_type.description: What kind of procedure this is: an open tender anyone qualified can apply for, a nominated tender (指名競争: only nominated companies), a request for comments/information (意見招請: not a tender), or a list of small goods items

title: 受付中の入札公告を探す
